scope: Dedicated hidden offscreen Electron development QA. No user browser, no CDP, no source changes.
protocol: Menu reference, then an active Arena containing actual spawned enemies, with HP/core refills only to hold the encounter.
The live Arena is subsequently paused at the scene-system level without a pause overlay. This freezes physics, timers, animation and gameplay together.
The exact same paused display list is sampled visible / ground-hidden / visible-restored. Only the depth -1 static Graphics visibility changes.
Ground-hidden screenshots are diagnostic controls, not the intended player presentation. TileSprite, map labels, trees and other Graphics remain visible.
All timings are inclusive synchronous JavaScript CPU submission spans. Nested spans must not be summed; residuals are calculated per frame.
rAF and paint intervals include browser/offscreen scheduling. No gl.finish, GPU timer queries, capture or inspector is used during samples.

phases.name: 01-menu
phases.note: Unmodified Menu reference: useful for the offscreen cadence floor, not content-matched to Arena.

phases.name: 02-arena-live
phases.note: Actual update/physics/render with automatic enemy spawning and companion actions. QA HP/core/enemy-HP refills prevent defeat or wave transitions. Population may vary and is recorded each second; this is not the ground A/B control.

phases.name: 03-arena-frozen-visible
phases.note: Frozen scene-system baseline; actual enemies/bullets retained, gameplay CPU intentionally absent.

phases.name: 04-arena-frozen-ground-hidden
phases.note: Identical frozen scene, only static Graphics depth -1 hidden. Diagnostic visual control, not player presentation.

phases.name: 05-arena-frozen-restored
phases.note: Same frozen scene and ground visibility restored; detects one-way warmup or scheduling drift.

renderer.rendererName: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (0x00002520) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
renderer.performanceClock: performance.now(); native precision, no synthetic smoothing

comparison.inferenceRule: Use per-frame CPU attribution plus reversible state-matched render-cost change to assess a static-cache candidate. Cadence alone cannot separate GPU/compositor/offscreen scheduling; JS submission spans do not measure GPU execution.
